module: "Playbook Mission Tree Viewer" window associated with editor_missionPlaybook. It draws, with the flowgraph node editor (ui_flowgraph_editor), the career mission unlock tree: one node per mission (showInCareer), placed according to the forwardInfo.depth depth, linked to the missions it unlocks (forwardIds). The color indicates the state (green startable, yellow visible, red otherwise) and star icons show the stars unlocked at the current playbook step (full star, empty, or "stars" for unlocked at this step).
notes: You must click "Generate" to create the nodes (generateNodes); otherwise M.nodes stays empty.
The window is only drawn if "Mission Playbook" is visible and book.results[book.page] exists.
Bug: M.onEditorRegisterPreferences is assigned to an undefined global variable (nil).
Debug code (dump) remains active in onEditorGui and onPlaybookLogAfterStep.
createRect.is_empty references global (undefined) w and h; unused function.

show.desc: Shows the "Mission Playbook" and "Playbook Mission Tree Viewer" windows.

onEditorGui.desc: Editor hook called every frame: creates (once) a dedicated node editor context, draws the nodes and links then restores the previous context.

onEditorInitialized.desc: Hook called at editor initialization: registers the window (500x500) and the "Missions" menu entry.

onPlaybookLogAfterStep.desc: Hook emitted after each playbook instruction: adds to resultData the stars unlocked per mission (unlockedStars) and those unlocked at this step (unlockedThisStep).

resultData.desc: Result of the step, modified in place.
